reduction_argument: zero_count=0 is automatic. For z>2, change all but two zeros to ones; coordinatewise monotonicity of compare-exchange networks implies that if both selected outputs are zero for every z=2 input, they remain zero for the smaller input with additional zeros. Thus z=1 and z=2 are complete for U(2,n).
scope: SAT witness search only; UNKNOWN/TIMEOUT is not UNSAT
